Signature.purpose: Docs file-tree navigator — renders nested dir/file structure and updates nav doc param on selection
Signature.description: Walks `@bookIndex.nodes`, dispatching each entry to DocsTree.Dir or DocsTree.File by its `type`. Open state comes from `@bookIndex.openPath` and the persisted `@treeState`, so it needs a BookIndexTreeService mounted as Ref="bookIndex" above it.
